aviso.entrada: This is the information required by article 10 of Spanish Act 34/2002 on information society services and electronic commerce (LSSI-CE): who is responsible for this website and on what terms it may be used.

bloques.p: This website is informational: it presents the café, its menu and its location. It sells nothing online, takes no table bookings, and has no forms or user accounts. Ordering and payment always happen at the premises.
Using the site means accepting this legal notice as published at the time. The owner may change the content, presentation and configuration of the site whenever she sees fit.
The prices and allergens shown on the menu are the ones declared by the café and may change. Prices are in euros and include applicable taxes.

Allergen information is published under Regulation (EU) 1169/2011. We cook in a shared kitchen and cannot rule out traces: if you have an allergy or an intolerance, tell us at the counter before ordering.
If the menu on this site and the one at the premises differ, the one at the premises prevails.

The texts, photographs, logo and design of this website belong to the owner or are used with permission. They may not be reproduced, distributed or publicly communicated without written consent, other than uses expressly allowed by law.

Third-party names, trade marks and logos shown here —Instagram, Google, Restaurant Guru— belong to their respective owners and are cited only to identify them. The map is drawn from OpenStreetMap data, © its contributors, available under the ODbL licence.

This website links to outside services such as Instagram and Google Maps. The owner does not control those sites and is not responsible for their content or for the data processing they carry out: once you follow a link, their own terms and policies apply. The map shown on the website is an image of our own: nothing is loaded from Google unless you follow the link.
Reasonable care is taken to keep the published information correct and up to date, but it is not guaranteed to be free of errors, nor is the site guaranteed to be available at all times.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.), so its availability depends on that provider. No liability is accepted for outages, network failures or third-party incidents that prevent access to the site.
The processing of personal data connected with this website is explained in the privacy policy, linked at the bottom of this page and in the site footer.

This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. Any dispute will be heard by the courts that have jurisdiction under the applicable rules; where the other party is a consumer, the courts of their own domicile.
Official complaint forms are available to customers at the premises.
For anything concerning this legal notice: {email} or {telefono}.

privacidad.entrada: What personal data is processed through this website, why, on what legal basis and what you can do about it. Written under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Act 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

bloques.p: There is no data protection officer: this activity is not among those that require one (art. 37 GDPR).
This website has no forms, creates no user accounts, uses no cookies and carries no analytics or advertising tools. The only processing operations are the ones described below.

datos: Whatever you include in your message or call: name, email address, phone number and the content of the enquiry.
To handle and answer what you ask us.
Your own request: pre-contractual steps and legitimate interest in replying to whoever writes to us (art. 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(f) GDPR).
For as long as the exchange lasts and, afterwards, as long as needed to answer for any obligations arising from it.
Email is received in a Gmail mailbox provided by Google, which may access the messages under its own terms.
IP address, date and time, page requested, browser and operating system.
To serve the pages, keep the site secure and detect abuse.
Legitimate interest in providing and protecting the service (art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Whatever period the hosting provider applies. No copy of those logs is kept by us.
GitHub, Inc. (Microsoft group), which hosts the site on GitHub Pages.

bloques.p: The map you see on this website is an image served by this website itself, drawn from OpenStreetMap data. It is not an embedded Google map: looking at it sends nothing to anyone, asks for no data, stores no data and needs no consent from you.

If you press the map or the “Open in Google Maps” link, you leave this website and enter Google Maps, a Google service with its own privacy policy. From that point on the processing is done by Google, and we receive no data about your visit.
The Instagram link takes you off this website. From that point on the processing is done by Meta under its own policy, and we receive no data about your visit.

secciones.titulo: What is stored in your browser

bloques.p: This website uses no cookies. It stores a single item in the browser's local storage, and only if you cause it:

datos: To remember the language you chose, so it is not asked again on your next visit. It is only written if you press the language selector: the language detected from your browser is not stored.
The language code: es, ca, en or de. It identifies nobody.
Until you clear it from your browser.
Not required: it is a preference you chose yourself and is exempt under art. 22.2 LSSI.

bloques.p: Since there are no cookies and no third-party trackers, this website does not need a cookie banner.

Hosting the site on GitHub Pages means GitHub, Inc. (United States) processes the connection logs. GitHub belongs to the Microsoft group, which is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework covered by the European Commission adequacy decision of 10 July 2023, and additionally applies standard contractual clauses.
If you write to the Gmail mailbox, Google may process data outside the European Economic Area under equivalent safeguards.
Data is neither sold nor transferred to third parties. It is disclosed only to public authorities and courts where a legal obligation requires it, and to the providers named in this policy.

You may exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw any consent you gave at any time, by writing to {email} or by post to the address given above. Tell us which right you are exercising and include something that lets us identify you.
If you believe your request was not handled properly, you may complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency: C/ Jorge Juan 6, 28001 Madrid, www.aepd.es.
No profiling or automated decision-making takes place. The site is not aimed at children under 14 and does not knowingly collect their data.
This policy will be updated if the processing operations or the applicable rules change. The date of the last revision appears at the top of the page.
